Statutory prescriptions of history as a specific subject in the American public school had their beginning in the years between 1827 and 1860; yet the way for such enactments had been charted by earlier educational legislation.

arxiv-1807-06953.title: Emergent Democracy
arxiv-1807-06953.creator: Joichi Ito
arxiv-1807-06953.description: Abstract This essay argues that a new form of democracy — an “Emergent Democracy” — will develop as a result of the use of Internet communication tools and platforms such as blogs. The essay explores a variety of tools available and explores the history of democracy, modern experiments with democracy and how these tools might support democracy.

arxiv-2012-08624.title: Post-Hurricane Damage Assessment Using Satellite Imagery and Geolocation Features
arxiv-2012-08624.creator: Quoc Dung Cao, Youngjun Choe
arxiv-2012-08624.description: Abstract Gaining timely and reliable situation awareness after hazard events such as a hurricane is crucial to emergency managers and first responders. One effective way to achieve that goal is through damage assessment. Recently, disaster researchers have been utilizing imagery captured through satellites or drones to quantify the number of flooded/damaged buildings.

arxiv-2102-11291.title: AT 2019qyl in NGC 300: Internal Collisions in the Early Outflow from a Very Fast Nova in a Symbiotic Binary This paper includes data gathered with the 6.5 m Magellan Telescopes located at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile. Based on observations made with the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope , obtained
arxiv-2102-11291.creator: Jacob E. Jencson, Jennifer E. Andrews, Howard E. Bond, Viraj Karambelkar, David J. Sand, Schuyler D. van Dyk, Nadejda Blagorodnova, Martha L. Boyer, Mansi M. Kasliwal, Ryan M. Lau, Shazrene Mohamed, Robert Williams, Patricia A. Whitelock, Rachael C. Amaro, K. Azalee Bostroem, Yize Dong, Michael J. L
arxiv-2102-11291.description: Abstract Nova eruptions, thermonuclear explosions on the surfaces of white dwarfs (WDs), are now recognized to be among the most common shock-powered astrophysical transients. We present the early discovery and rapid ultraviolet (UV), optical, and infrared (IR) temporal development of AT 2019qyl, a recent nova in the nearby Sculptor Group galaxy NGC 300.

arxiv-2106-13240.title: Iterative LP-based Methods for the Multiperiod Optimal Electricity and Gas Flow Problem
arxiv-2106-13240.creator: Sleiman Mhanna, Member, IEEE , Isam Saedi, Student Member, IEEE , Pierluigi Mancarella, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2106-13240.description: Abstract In light of the increasing coupling between electricity and gas networks, this paper introduces two novel iterative methods for efficiently solving the multiperiod optimal electricity and gas flow (MOEGF) problem. The first is an iterative MILP-based method and the second is an iterative LP-based method with an elaborate procedure for ensuring an integral solution.

arxiv-2107-05691.title: Scalable estimation of pure multi-qubit states
arxiv-2107-05691.creator: L. Pereira, L. Zambrano, A. Delgado
arxiv-2107-05691.description: Abstract We introduce an inductive n n -qubit pure-state estimation method. This is based on projective measurements on states of 2 ​ n 2n +1 separable bases or 2 2 entangled bases plus the computational basis. Thus, the total number of measurement bases scales as O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) and O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) , respectively.

arxiv-2206-02159.title: X-ray intraday variability of the TeV blazar Mrk 421 with XMM-Newton
arxiv-2206-02159.creator: A Priyana Noel, Haritma Gaur, Alok C. Gupta, Alicja Wierzcholska, Michał Ostrowski, Vinit Dhiman, Gopal Bhatta
arxiv-2206-02159.description: Abstract Highly variable Markarian 421 is a bright high synchrotron energy peaked blazar showing wide featureless non-thermal spectrum making it a good candidate for our study of intraday flux and spectral variations over time. We analyse its X-ray observations of over 17 years taken with the EPIC-PN instrument to probe into the intraday variability properties.

arxiv-2206-12796.title: Transferring Fairness under Distribution Shifts via Fair Consistency Regularization
arxiv-2206-12796.creator: Bang An, Zora Che, Mucong Ding, Furong Huang
arxiv-2206-12796.description: Abstract The increasing reliance on ML models in high-stakes tasks has raised a major concern about fairness violations. Although there has been a surge of work that improves algorithmic fairness, most are under the assumption of an identical training and test distribution.

Our methods are based on finding the optimal version of the Sobolev embedding theorem. 1. Introduction In this text we establish three main results.

arxiv-2405-04178.title: New degeneration phenomenon for infinite-type Riemann surfaces Thanks: The author was supported in part by JST, the establishment of the University Fellowship Program for the Creation of Innovation in Science and Technology, Grant Number JPMJFS2123
arxiv-2405-04178.creator: Ryo Matsuda
arxiv-2405-04178.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ryo Matsuda. Since the Teichmüller space of a surface R R is a deformation space of complex structures defined on R R , its Bers boundary describes the degeneration of complex structures in a certain sense. In this paper, constructing a concrete example, we prove that if S is a Riemann surface of infinite type, a Riemann surface with the marking exists, which is homeomorphic to the surface R R in the Bers boundary.

arxiv-2510-08689.title: Metals versus Non-metals: Chemical Evolution of Hydrogen and Helium Isotopes in the Milky Way
arxiv-2510-08689.creator: James W. Johnson, Miqaela K. Weller, Ryan J. Cooke
arxiv-2510-08689.description: Abstract Star formation drives changes in the compositions of galaxies, fusing H and He into heavier nuclei. This paper investigates the differences in abundance evolution between metal and non-metal isotopes using recent models of Galactic chemical evolution appropriate for the thin disk epoch.

arxiv-2602-06991.title: LangGS-SLAM: Real-Time Language-Feature Gaussian Splatting SLAM
arxiv-2602-06991.creator: Seongbo Ha, Sibaek Lee, Kyungsu Kang, Joonyeol Choi, Seungjun Tak, Hyeonwoo Yu
arxiv-2602-06991.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a RGBD SLAM system that reconstructs a language-aligned dense feature field while sustaining low-latency tracking and mapping. First, we introduce a Top-K Rendering pipeline, a high-throughput and semantic-distortion-free method for efficiently rendering high-dimensional feature maps.

pmc-10720086.title: Cyclosporine A alleviates colitis by inhibiting the formation of neutrophil extracellular traps via the regulating pentose phosphate pathway
pmc-10720086.creator: Chenjing Xu, Ziping Ye, Wenyu Jiang, Shu Wang, Hongjie Zhang
pmc-10720086.description: BackgroundThe aberrant formation of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) has been implicated in ulcerative colitis (UC), a chronic recurrent intestinal inflammation. Cyclosporine A (CsA) is now applied as rescue therapy for acute severe UC. In addition, it has been certained that CsA inhibits the formation of NETs in vitro and the mechanism of which was still vague.

pmc-11638162.title: RNA sequencing reveals dynamic expression of genes related to innate immune responses in canine small intestinal epithelial cells induced by Echinococcus granulosus protoscoleces
pmc-11638162.creator: Zhengrong Wang, Na Pu, Wenqing Zhao, Xuke Chen, Yanyan Zhang, Yan Sun, Xinwen Bo
pmc-11638162.description: BackgroundDogs are definitive hosts of Echinococcus granulosus, with the small intestine being the only site of parasitic infections. However, the immunomodulatory processes that occur during interactions between E. granulosus and its definitive host remain unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate gene transcription patterns in canine small intestinal epithelial cells (CIECs) following stimulation by E. granulosus protoscoleces (PSCs).

pmc-12471766.title: Endodontic Sealers and Innovations to Enhance Their Properties: A Current Review
pmc-12471766.creator: Anna Błaszczyk-Pośpiech, Natalia Struzik, Maria Szymonowicz, Przemysław Sareło, Maria Wiśniewska-Wrona, Kamila Wiśniewska, Maciej Dobrzyński, Magdalena Wawrzyńska, Maria Francesca Sfondrini, Andrea Scribante
pmc-12471766.description: Endodontic sealers are crucial for achieving an effective root canal obturation, preventing reinfection and promoting long-term treatment success. This review categorizes sealers by chemical composition, including traditional types such as zinc oxide-eugenol, glass ionomer, silicone, methacrylate and epoxy resins, calcium hydroxide, and the latest bioceramic formulations.

pmc-12521517.title: Comparison of three behavioral cardioception tasks and heartbeat evoked potentials in the same group of healthy volunteers
pmc-12521517.creator: Irina Minenko, Alena Limonova, Anastasia Sukmanova, Vladimir Kutsenko, Maria Nazarova, Alexandra Ershova, Oxana Drapkina
pmc-12521517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cardioception is the ability of the central nervous system to process signals from the heart. Methods for determining cardioception are still under discussion. In the present study, we considered metrics for cardiac interoceptive accuracy (CA) assessments in three behavioral cardioception tasks − (1) the heartbeat tapping (HTT), (2) the heartbeat discrimination (HDT), and (3) the heartbeat counting (HCT) - and heartbeat evoked potentials (HEP) recorded by an electroencephalography during resting state and the tasks.

pmc-12595020.title: Deep learning models simultaneously trained on multiple datasets improve base-editing activity prediction
pmc-12595020.creator: Ying Sun, Kunli Qu, Giulia I Corsi, Christian Anthon, Xiaoguang Pan, Xi Xiang, Lars Juhl Jensen, Lin Lin, Yonglun Luo, Jan Gorodkin
pmc-12595020.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). CRISPR-derived base editors (BE) enable precise single nucleotide substitution without introducing double-stranded DNA breaks. Apart from the base editing enzymes, efficient base editing strongly depends on both the CRISPR guide RNA (gRNA) efficiency and the edited position. Here, we show that the accuracy of BE gRNA design can be significantly improved by generating more data and by introducing deep neural networks trained on multiple different datasets simultaneously.

pmc-12610307.title: The Impact of Storage Conditions on the Gas-Forming Tendency of Moulds and Cores Made with Resole-Type Phenol Formaldehyde Resin
pmc-12610307.creator: Artur Bobrowski, Faustyna Woźniak, Sylwia Żymankowska-Kumon, Hubert Ziętal, Kacper Januszek, Beata Grabowska, Marcin Stawarz, Krzysztof Janerka, Jan Jezierski
pmc-12610307.description: The article presents the results of a study aimed at determining the impact of storage conditions on the gas-forming tendency of standard samples (cores) made from moulding sand using a two-component binder based on resole-type phenolic resin, cured with a dedicated ester mixture.

pmc-13054018.title: Non-Reducing Proteomics Reveals Disulfide-dependent Proteoform Remodeling Under Oxidative Stress
pmc-13054018.creator: Yeonjoo Lee, Tae-Kyung Kim, Seungjin Na, Kong-Joo Lee, Jaeho Jeong, Eun Joo Song
pmc-13054018.description: Oxidative stress triggers redox-sensitive post-translational modifications, notably disulfide bond formation involving cysteine residues. However, these bonds are often overlooked in proteomics due to the routine use of reducing agents. Here, we employed (LC-MS based metabolomics and non-reducing tandem mass tag proteomics to investigate the effects of hydrogen peroxide on MDA-MB-231 cells.

pmc-13265175.title: Epidemiology and prognostic factors of acute erythroid leukemia
pmc-13265175.creator: Shan Liu, Yaobin Lin
pmc-13265175.description: BackgroundAcute erythroid leukemia (AEL) is a rare, highly aggressive subtype of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) characterized by a propensity for early progression and recurrence and is associated with an unfavorable overall prognosis. However, the epidemiological characteristics and risk factors associated with AEL remain poorly understood.

pmc-13474012.title: Multilayer modeling reveals an endogenous retrovirus signature predictive of induction chemotherapy failure in AML
pmc-13474012.creator: Nogayhan Seymen, Sila Gerlevik, I Richard Thompson, Merilyn M Albuquerque, Anastasia Conti, Chi Wai Eric So, Mohammad M Karimi
